title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**Company:** Benzara E\-Commerce India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** AI Agent Engineer  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent  
**Location:** On\-site

***About the Role***

We are looking for an **AI Agent Engineer** who can design, build, and deploy AI agents to automate **content creation, research, reporting, and e\-commerce workflows**. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with **Agentic AI frameworks, LLM APIs, Python, automation, and API integrations**.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design and deploy AI agents using **LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI/Claude Agents SDKs**, or similar frameworks.
* Build multi\-step AI workflows involving **planning, tool/API calls, and self\-correction**.
* Automate **product titles, descriptions, specifications, keywords, and marketing content**.
* Automate product data **collection, cleaning, categorization, attribute mapping, and validation**.
* Build AI solutions for **market, competitor, and product research**.
* Automate **sales, inventory, pricing, SEO, PPC, and marketplace reporting**.
* Integrate internal systems, marketplaces, portals, and tools using **REST APIs and webhooks**.
* Work with **Excel, CSV, JSON, SQL, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or Power BI**.
* Work with AI\-based **image processing, enhancement, background removal, and image generation**.
* Monitor, debug, and improve AI agents and automated workflows.
* Collaborate with business and operations teams to convert requirements into practical AI solutions.
* Maintain documentation for agent workflows, APIs, and automation logic.

*Required Skills*

* Good working knowledge of **Python**
* Hands\-on experience with at least one **Agentic AI framework/SDK**
* Strong understanding of **Generative AI, LLMs, and Prompt Engineering**
* Experience with **OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar LLM APIs**
* Knowledge of **REST APIs, JSON, Webhooks, and third\-party integrations**
* Experience with automation tools such as **n8n, Make, Zapier, or Power Automate**
* Knowledge of **Excel/CSV, structured data, and basic SQL**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* **RAG and vector databases** such as Pinecone, Chroma, or FAISS are a plus
* E\-commerce/marketplace integration experience is an advantage

*Experience*

**1–2 years** of experience in AI/AI\-agentic development, GenAI, automation, Python, or API integration is preferred. Candidates with fewer years but **strong hands\-on AI agent/automation projects** will also be considered.

*Qualifications*

* **BCA**
* **B.Tech /B.E.** in Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence \& Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence \& Machine Learning
* **MCA** in Computers, Artificial Intelligence \& Machine Learning

Candidates with demonstrable **GitHub repositories or portfolios involving AI agents or automation pipelines** will be preferred.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Director AI/ML Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

We are seeking a seasoned Director, AI/ML Engineering to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of enterprise\-scale AI solutions within the healthcare domain. This role will drive initiatives across contract digitization, document intelligence, claims research automation, NLP, LLMs, and Generative AI solutions while leading cross\-functional teams of AI/ML engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and cloud engineers.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute the AI/ML strategy aligned with business objectives
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of AI\-powered healthcare solutions
* Drive innovation in contract digitization, intelligent document processing, claims automation, and GenAI applications
* Establish scalable AI/ML platforms, MLOps practices, governance, and engineering standards
* Guide cloud\-native architecture using Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Document Intelligence, AI Search, Databricks, and Kubernetes
* Build, mentor, and grow high\-performing AI engineering teams
* Partner with business and technology leaders to drive AI adoption and measurable outcomes
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field
* 12\+ years of technology experience
* 8\+ years of engineering leadership experience
* 5\+ years leading enterprise AI/ML programs
* Experience in healthcare, payer, provider, PBM, or regulated industries
* Experience with Core Technical Skills
	+ AI/ML and GenAI
		- Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP
		- LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI
		- RAG, Semantic Search, Knowledge Graphs
		- Predictive Analytics and Classification Models
	+ Document Intelligence
		- OCR, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)
		- Contract Analytics
		- Information Extraction and Document Understanding
	+ Cloud and Platforms
		- Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML
		- Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence
		- Databricks, Cosmos DB
		- Kubernetes, Docker
	+ Engineering Excellence
		- MLOps, CI/CD, DevOps
		- Infrastructure as Code
		- Model Governance and Responsible AI
		- Monitoring and Observability
* Proven track record delivering production\-scale AI solutions

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree
* Healthcare contract digitization solutions experience
* Claims, provider, reimbursement, or payment integrity workflows experience
* RAG and Agentic AI implementations experience
* Enterprise AI transformation programs experience
* Experience in managing globally distributed teams

 **Success Measures:**

* Successful delivery of AI programs
* Business value from AI adoption and automation
* Improved operational efficiency
* Scalable, reliable, and gover

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. title: Data Scientist
description:
**Job Description: Band B1 / B2 — Sierra Engineer**

**Experience**

* 4–6 years total in Conversational AI / agentic or virtual\-assistant development (e.g., Dialogflow CX, Amelia, Kore.ai, Rasa, LLM\-based agents).
* 1–2 years hands\-on Sierra, with at least one delivered/production Sierra project.
* Strong programming background in TypeScript / JavaScript.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Build and validate agents in Agent Studio using Journeys, Conditions, Rules, Policies, Tools, and Configuration.
* Implement code\-defined agent behaviour in the Agent SDK (TypeScript/JSX on Sierra's custom runtime) using hooks, tool registration, and lifecycle events.
* Author instruction\-driven and scenario\-based simulations (Studio and code) and keep them stable and meaningful.
* Integrate agents with APIs and enterprise/contact\-centre systems, including transfer/routing to queues and numbers with attached data.
* Participate in workspace\-based development: merge requests, snapshots, and workspace reviews.
* Execute releases under guidance, respecting critical\-simulation gates and approvals.
* Contribute to CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions) — running simulations and wiring release checks.

**Mandatory Skills (per Sierra platform)**

* **Agent Studio: conversational design, customer journeys, and the block\-based editor (Journeys, Conditions, Rules, Policies, Tools, Configuration).**
* **Agent SDK: TypeScript/JavaScript with JSX; SDK APIs (hooks, tool registration, lifecycle events); code\-defined simulations; workspace/snapshot/release concepts.**
* **Simulations: writing instruction\-driven and scenario\-based tests; critical\-simulation enforcement; stabilising flaky simulations.**
* **Git \& CI/CD: branching, merging, code reviews; running simulations and release enforcement in pipelines.**

**Good to Have**

* Ghostwriter (AI\-assisted authoring): prompting, reviewing, validating, and merging AI\-generated journeys/simulations.
* Basic observability (traces/alerts) and analytics (CSAT, resolution/containment rate).
* Contact\-centre / IVR and telephony transfer (Genesys or similar) exposure.

  
Responsibilities: Design and develop data models and analytical solutions, Optimize data analysis processes and methodologies, Ensure data solutions meet business and technical requirements, Provide technical support for data science projects, Collaborate with stakeholders to address data science needs.


  
Qualifications: Bachelor's/Master's in Engineering 2\-5 years
